requirement: Every control has immutable identity and version history
Applicability decisions are jurisdiction-, sponsor-, partner-, entity- and period-aware
Each control records risk, objective, obligations, materiality and dependency relationships
Each active control has a named owner, backup and independent reviewer
Owner and reviewer conflicts are prevented by authorization rules
Delegation and reassignment require acceptance, expiry and full history
Agents may draft controls and cases but cannot activate, self-review or self-certify
Control activation requires approved version, scope, evidence producer and failure behavior
Evidence expectation is explicit for transactions, schedules, exceptions and zero activity
Missing or stale evidence never becomes automatic pass
Control results preserve independent evidence, denominator, evaluated period and scope
Monitoring failures create deficiencies with safe operational fallback
Control changes trigger dependency impact assessment and reapproval when material
Historical evaluations remain tied to effective control versions
Negative tests and sample populations are defined before assurance claims
Testing distinguishes design validation from operating effectiveness
Deficiencies have severity, exposure, ownership, due date, remediation and retest
Deficiency closure requires independent evidence and reviewer authority
Compensating controls have documented expiry, limits and independent approval
Emergency suspension preserves mandatory legal and financial safety constraints
Retirement requires dependency review and successor/no-longer-applicable justification
Control dashboards cannot label design completion as regulatory compliance
Evidence exports include missing items, redaction, provenance and limitations
Every material action is auditable and tenant-isolated
Control operations support sponsor and partner variation without duplicating authoritative policy
Control ownership and reviewer tasks are accessible on mobile and desktop
Tasks show next authorized action, reason, urgency and evidence required
Financial controls bind independent source reconciliation and accounting assertions
Legal assertions require qualified review and versioned applicability
Live payment execution remains prohibited until separately authorized
Control-to-requirement mappings require semantic review, not keyword coverage alone
Sponsor administration cannot bypass independent governance or legal authority
